databaseRoutes.description: Whether the composition routes databases by name (database-routes, ADR 0137). kore sets it only while the flag is on; off renders the manifests as before.

platformDomain.description: The environment's platform.domain, which kore passes with databaseRoutes.

organizationId.description: The environment's platform.organizationId, which kore passes with databaseRoutes; the derived host is <database>.<organizationId>.<platformDomain>.

gateway.description: The shared Gateway a database's TLS route attaches to, and its passthrough listener (ADR 0136). kore passes the name and namespace from the environment's gateway while database-routes is on.
